title: ShatteredCrown SMP
description: Welcome to ShatteredCrown SMP a community-driven Minecraft survival server built on trust creativity and adventure
body:
👑 ShatteredCrown SMP

The Crown may be shattered… but the realm still stands.

Welcome to ShatteredCrown SMP, a community-driven Minecraft survival server built on trust, creativity, and adventure.

🏰 Build incredible bases and kingdoms

🤝 Form alliances with other players

⚔️ Participate in fair PvP duels

🛒 Trade and create a thriving economy

Unlike chaotic anarchy servers, ShatteredCrown SMP focuses on a respectful community where players can build amazing things without fear of griefing or stealing.

✨ What we offer

🛡️ No griefing or stealing

⚔️ Fair and consensual PvP

🏗️ Massive builds and kingdoms

🤝 Friendly community

🌍 Clean and well-maintained world

Whether you want to become a legendary builder, a wealthy trader, or a powerful warrior, your story begins here.

👑 The crown awaits its next ruler.

🎮 Server IP: shatteredcrown.minefort.com
💬 Discord: [Discord](https://discord.gg/7d33w9pCT6)

Join ShatteredCrown SMP and become part of the realm.
